name: ai-popups-deprecation
notes: HYPOTHETICAL change (AI Pop-ups are NOT really being deprecated): a test ticket for discovery only; never draft or publish fixes from it. Confirmed 2026-11-10 by Diya Sharma from a combined list of both modes' picks plus a wording scan (25 articles). Scope: AI Pop-up generation, the AI generated image toggle and agentic Pop-up creation are removed; past release notes are historical (not affected). `action: archive` marks the article to archive rather than edit. `ignore`: excluded from scoring by the writer (a cloned test page).

ticket.description: The AI based Popup generation feature is being removed from the Whatfix Studio and it will no long er be available as a feature to the users. The AI generated image toggle is going along with AI Popups. Agentic creation of Popups will not be supported after this change. Product lines: DAP for Web

change_note.summary: The AI-based Popup generation feature is being removed from Whatfix Studio and will no longer be available. The AI generated image toggle is removed along with it, and agentic creation of Popups is no longer supported.
change_note.old: Users could generate Popups with AI in Whatfix Studio, including an AI generated image toggle and agentic Popup creation.
change_note.new: AI generated Popups, the AI generated image toggle, and agentic creation of Popups are no longer available in Whatfix Studio.
change_note.notes: No effective date stated. No old UI names (buttons, menus) given in the ticket. Manually created Popups are presumably still supported, but the ticket doesn't say so explicitly. Only the AI generation path is described as removed.
